text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Do you have a moment after this today?
choice_data_list: Sure, but what's up?
Sure, but what's up?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I received an invitation... ...They said 
they wanted to thank me. ...And that you 
should definitely come too.
choice_data_list: A token of gratitude...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ayabe-saaan...! Over hereee...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-Welcome, everyone! To the Opera O 
Revue's special performance~...!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-oneechan and everyone, welcome-e-e!!
choice_data_list: Could it be...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes~! That play you helped interview for 
the other day is finally finished~...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to talk to these kids, entertain 
them with a play, and give them a warm 
welcome...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Well, I do still have some 
worries, though.

text_block_list.name: Cheeky Boy
text_block_list.text:
Don't blame me if you regret saying that! 
My abs literally ripped from laughing so 
hard!

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable-Looking Boy
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, it's a grand spectacle 
blending legend with real-life 
experiences!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Girl
text_block_list.text:
"T.M. Opera Beam" is super sparkly! It's 
so cool!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, yeah.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, brave warrior! My dearest friend! 
Countless seasons have passed searching 
for the legendary blade—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Have you finally returned to the side of 
the Overlord at last?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Loo~~...♪ I'm ba~~ck...♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let me know of your safety! Tell me of 
your adventures!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Saved by the twinkling star spirit, you 
seeee~... Even across the dangerous 
suspension bridge where a giant awaits~♪"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
They say it's the bridge of a terrifying 
giant~♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Through bubbling~ poison swamps~ guided by 
the star sprite~ I have crooo-ooossed 
overrrr~♪
choice_data_list: (Isn't this from that interview...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...That wasn't the kind of place it was at 
all, was it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O fair spirit of the stars~ we thank 
thee~! For here assembled are helmet and 
sword~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Illuminate the world~! ...Here goes! 
'T.M. Opera BEEEEAM!!!'"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! BEEEEEEEEAM!!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
S-So bright...! Is this really where I'm 
supposed to put all my strength...!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now then, everyone! How was that?!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: That was so much fuuuun!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Well, it's better than I imagined...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's great! Now then, once more, 
Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I heard from Doto! Today's performance 
wouldn't have been possible without your 
help, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Please accept this!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we head back?
choice_data_list:
That was pretty incredible in a lot of 
ways.
That was really amazing in so many ways.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's flashy, and the dramatization 
is over the top. There are only two people 
in it, yet it's way too chaotic...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Still, it wasn't half bad.
choice_data_list: A bouquet was nice too, wasn't it?
A bouquet was nice too, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
... I always thought that anything beyond 
words would just be a burden.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Still, words alone cannot always settle 
the heart. There are times when they just 
aren't enough, right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So, I tried taking it... but it wasn't 
heavy at all. ...Though it was dazzling 
and quite noisy.
choice_data_list:
“Things” are an important way of showing 
how you feel, too.

Tangible "things" are a meaningful 
expression of feelings too, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That's true.
choice_data_list: Looking forward to the next "Opera" too!

I'm looking forward to the next "Opera" 
too!
Where should we display those flowers?
Where should we put those flowers?
It really brings a tear to my eye...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That's true.
choice_data_list: Looking forward to the next "Opera" too!

I'm looking forward to the next "Opera" 
too!
Where should we display those flowers?
Where should we put those flowers?
It really brings a tear to my eye...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You've got to be kidding.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Spare me from searching for another 
legendary whatever. ...I've had quite 
enough for a while.

Admire Vega seemed exasperated, but you 
could tell she didn't entirely mind it 
either...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The trainer's office, right? That sounds 
good to me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If I put something in my dorm room, 
Curren-san will interrogate me about it, 
which is a pain...

As she speaks, her expression looks 
somewhat softer than usual.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What, all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
We pay our respects. That is all there is 
to it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...So stop making such a big deal out of 
it.

Her demeanor remained as cool as ever. 
Yet, something had undoubtedly shifted 
within Admire Vega.
